blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Dense self-expression matrices and full-affinity spectral clustering limit the scalability of subspace clustering. We introduce the Latent Orthogonal Optimization Model for Subspace Clustering (LoomSC), a framework that addresses both bottlenecks through projector factorization and exact spectral reduction. Motivated by the spectral structure of least-squares regression, LoomSC jointly learns latent features and a projector self-representation through two thin factors. Alternating Procrustes and least-squares updates preserve the sample factor’s orthogonality while keeping the coefficient matrix implicit. We construct a nonnegative quadratic affinity that preserves the projector’s support. An exact feature map then reduces its normalized spectral problem to an eigenproblem whose dimension depends only on the factor width. Neither the full affinity nor the sample Laplacian needs to be formed. Our analysis quantifies the projector approximation and identifies conditions for subspace preservation and within-subspace connectivity. For fixed dimensions and iteration budgets, the complete pipeline has linear time and memory complexity in the number of samples. Across five image-clustering benchmarks, LoomSC ranks first or second in all 15 dataset–metric comparisons against 9 state-of-the-art baselines. Its mean accuracy exceeds the highest baseline mean by 6.66 percentage points. Synthetic experiments scale to 500,000 samples while maintaining at least 99.8% accuracy.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: In several cases, high-dimensional data can be modeled by a generation process from the union of multiple low-dimensional linear subspaces. In this context, subspace clustering is a prominent unsupervised strategy that aims to partition the data into clusters by identifying these subspaces, where each cluster is defined by exactly one low-dimensional subspace. The subspace assumption is widely used in visual analysis and has been successfully exploited in several applications, such as image segmentation [ 1 ] , motion segmentation [ 2 , 3 ] , and face clustering [ 3 , 4 ] . For example, face images of a person can be represented by a low-dimensional subspace for a fixed pose and under Lambertian reflectance [ 5 ] .
blocks.zh: 在若干情况下,高维数据可以通过多个低维线性子空间的结合产生的一代过程来建模. 在这种情况下,子空间集群是一种突出的无监督策略,旨在通过识别这些子空间将数据分解为集群,其中每个集群由一个精确的低维子空间来定义. 子空间假设被广泛用于视觉分析,并在多个应用中被成功利用,如图像分解[1],运动分解[2,3],和相相聚[3,4]. 例如,一个人的面相图像可以用一个低维子空间来代表一个固定的姿势和在兰伯特反射下[5].

blocks.en: The most recent subspace clustering methods [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] follow a two-step strategy. First, these methods learn an affinity matrix that captures the similarity between points within the same subspace. Second, a graph clustering approach, such as spectral clustering, is used to identify the clusters. The affinity matrix is constructed according to the self-expression property [ 8 , 9 ] of the subspaces. More precisely, each data point can be expressed as a linear combination of points in the same subspace. blocks.en: Different regularizers encode complementary structural preferences. Sparse Subspace Clustering (SSC) [ 8 ] promotes sparse coefficients through an ℓ 1 \ell_{1} penalty. Low-Rank Representation (LRR) [ 10 ] favors a low-rank coefficient matrix through nuclear-norm regularization. Multi-Subspace Representation (MSR) [ 11 ] combines these penalties, whereas Block Diagonal Representation (BDR) [ 6 ] directly encourages a block structure. Least Squares Regression (LSR) [ 9 ] uses squared Frobenius regularization and admits a closed-form solution. Its grouping effect encourages correlated samples to receive similar coefficients. These formulations seek to suppress cross-subspace connections while retaining informative relations within each subspace. Both requirements matter because a sparse affinity can separate samples from different subspaces yet fragment samples from the same subspace [ 12 ] .

Low-Rank代表(LRR)[10]通过核规范化,倾向于低等系数矩阵. 多子空间代表[MSR][11]结合了这些处罚,而块对角代表[BDR][6]则直接鼓励块状结构. 最小平面回放(LSR)[9]使用平面的弗罗贝尼乌斯规范化并承认封闭式解决方案. 它的分组效应鼓励相关样本获得相类似的系数. 这些配方试图压制跨子空间连接,同时保留每个子空间内部的信息关系. 这两种要求都很重要,因为一个稀少的亲缘关系可以把样品从不同的子空间中分离出来,而碎片样品则从同一个子空间中分离出来[12].

blocks.en: The self-expression framework nevertheless introduces two distinct computational bottlenecks. Explicitly storing a dense coefficient matrix requires 𝒪 ⁡ ( n 2 ) \mathcal{O}(n^{2}) memory, even when its estimation admits an efficient solver. Constructing a full affinity retains this quadratic storage cost. The spectral stage adds a second bottleneck. A dense eigendecomposition requires 𝒪 ⁡ ( n 3 ) \mathcal{O}(n^{3}) operations, while partial eigensolvers still perform repeated products with the sample-level affinity. Consequently, accelerating coefficient estimation alone does not ensure a scalable clustering pipeline. Both self-expression and spectral assignment must avoid dense sample-by-sample computations.
blocks.zh: 然而,自我表达框架引入了两个不同的计算瓶颈。 明确存储稠密的系数矩阵需要 O QQ (n 2)\ mathcal{O}(n^{2}) 内存,即使其估计承认高效的解析器. 构建一个完整的亲和性保留了这个四相存储成本. 光谱相会增加第二个瓶颈. 密集的eigen分解需要O QQ (n 3)\ mathcal{O}(n^{3})操作,而部分eigensolvers仍然以样本级的亲和性进行重复的产品. 因此,单靠加速系数估计并不能保证可扩展的集群管道。 自我表达和光谱分配都必须避免密集的逐个样本计算.

blocks.en: Several strategies reduce these costs. Sampling methods replace the full dictionary with a smaller set of representatives [ 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] . Subspace-preserving selection seeks representatives that span the underlying subspaces [ 17 ] . Sparse solvers accelerate coefficient estimation through greedy pursuit [ 18 ] , active-set selection [ 19 ] , or stochastic dictionaries [ 20 ] . Structure-aware methods exploit compact graph models [ 21 ] or structured affinity estimation [ 22 ] . Neural coefficient predictors [ 23 ] provide another route by learning a mapping that replaces repeated regression.
blocks.zh: 一些战略降低了这些成本。 采样方法用更小的一组代表[13,14,15,16]来取而代之. 保留子空间的选择寻求跨越基础子空间的代表[17]. Sparse 解析器通过贪婪追求[18],活性设定选择[19],或花纹词典[20]来加速系数估计. 结构认识方法利用紧凑的图表模型[21]或结构上的亲和性估计[22]。 神经系数预测器 [23] 通过学习一种取代重复回归的映射提供了另一种路径.

blocks.en: Representative-based reduction is particularly attractive because it replaces an all-sample dictionary with m ≪ n m\ll n representatives. Each sample is then described by m m coefficients instead of n n . Anchor-graph methods can also obtain the spectral embedding from a compact factor [ 15 , 16 ] . Their effectiveness depends on how well the representatives capture the subspaces in the supplied feature space. Learning the coefficients improves the graph, but does not by itself adapt the image representation. This motivates a compact model in which both the representation and the directions used for self-expression are learned from the data.
blocks.zh: 基于代表性的删减特别有吸引力,因为它用 m \ n m\ll n 代表取代了全样词典. 然后,每个样本用m m 系数而不是n 系数来描述。 Anchor-graph方法也可以从收缩因子得到光谱嵌入[15,16]. 其有效性取决于代表们在所提供的地物空间中捕捉分空间的好坏。 学习系数可以改善图表,但本身并不能适应图像表现. 这促使形成一个紧凑的模式,从数据中学习自我表达的表述和方向。

blocks.en: The representation itself is important because complex appearance variation and data corruption can weaken the linear subspace structure of raw observations. Kernel methods address nonlinear structure through an implicit feature mapping [ 24 ] . Deep subspace clustering [ 25 , 26 , 27 ] instead couples an auto-encoder with self-expression in the latent space. The reconstruction objective preserves information about the inputs. The self-expression objective encourages latent features that conform to a subspace model. Joint optimization therefore adapts the features to clustering rather than imposing self-expression on a fixed representation.
blocks.zh: 表现本身很重要,因为复杂的外观变异和数据腐败会削弱原始观测的线性亚空间结构. 内核方法通过隐含的特征映射来解决非线性结构[24]. 深潜空间组合 [25, 26, 27] 相反, 与一个自动编码器在潜在空间中自我表达。 重建目标保存有关投入的信息。 自我表达目标鼓励符合子空间模型的潜在特征。 因此,联合优化使特征适应集群,而不是将自我表达强加于固定代表。

blocks.en: Joint learning also makes computational compactness essential. A dense self-expression layer introduces n 2 n^{2} sample-dependent coefficients that must be optimized together with the encoder [ 25 , 26 ] . Neural parameterizations and mini-batch training can reduce training costs [ 28 ] , but do not by themselves eliminate full-affinity spectral inference. Our goal is to retain both pairwise self-expression and normalized spectral clustering while learning nonlinear representations, without constructing dense sample-level matrices at either stage.
blocks.zh: 联合学习也使得计算紧凑性至关重要. 密集的自表达层引入了 n 2 n^{2} 样本依赖系数,必须与编码器一起优化. [25, 26]. 神经参数化和小批量培训可以降低培训成本[28],但本身并不能消除全方位光谱推断. 我们的目标是在学习非线性表述的同时,保留双向自表达和正常的光谱组合,而不在两个阶段构建密集的样本级矩阵。

blocks.en: To this end, we introduce the Latent Orthogonal Optimization Model for Subspace Clustering (LoomSC). Motivated by the spectral structure of LSR, LoomSC represents self-expression through a projector C = P ​ P ⊤ C=PP^{\top} . The sample factor P ∈ ℝ n × m P\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times m} has orthonormal columns and a prescribed width m m . An equivalent two-factor objective separates latent directions from sample coefficients and couples both to the auto-encoder. Alternating Procrustes and least-squares updates refine these factors while preserving orthogonality. Neither the coefficient matrix nor a sample Gram matrix needs to be formed. The latent directions are updated using all samples rather than remaining fixed to selected representatives. Our analysis quantifies the projector approximation to LSR and identifies conditions under which the full row-space projector preserves subspace memberships and within-subspace connectivity.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们引入了子空间集群(LoomSC)的Latet Orthogonal优化模型. 由LSR的光谱结构所激发出,LoomSC通过投影仪C = P P → C = PP^{\top } 来代表自我表达. 样本因子 P → R n → m P\in\ mathbb{ R\ n\ times m} 有正态列和规定宽度 m. 等同的两要素目标将潜在方向从样本系数和夫妇两者区分为自动编码器。 取代蛋白质和最不平方的更新在保留正交性的同时对这些因素进行了完善. 既不需要形成系数矩阵,也不需要形成格莱克样本矩阵。 利用所有样本更新潜在方向,而不是固定在选定的代表身上。 我们的分析量化了投影仪对LSR的近似值,并确定了全行空间投影仪保留子空间会籍和子空间内部连接的条件.

blocks.en: LoomSC extends this compact representation to spectral assignment through a nonnegative quadratic affinity. Squaring the projector coefficients preserves their zero pattern and thus retains the connections encoded by self-expression. An exact feature map represents this affinity using q = m ⁡ ( m + 1 ) / 2 q=m(m+1)/2 features per sample. Its normalized spectral problem then reduces to a q q -dimensional eigenproblem. This reduction avoids forming either the full affinity or the sample Laplacian. For fixed dimensions and iteration budgets, the complete pipeline has linear time and memory complexity in n n . The same compact representation therefore supports feature learning, self-expression, and global spectral assignment.
blocks.zh: LoomSC通过非负四相亲和性将这种紧凑的表示法扩展到光谱分配. 组合投影器系数保留了它们的零模式,从而保留了由自表达编码的连接. 一个精确的地物映射代表这个亲和性,每个样本使用q=m (m+1)/2q=m(m+1)/2个地物. 它的正态光谱问题再减小为q-q-维等相. 这种还原可以避免形成完全亲和或样品Laplacian. 对于固定维度和迭代预算,完整的管道在n 中具有线性时间和内存复杂性. 因此,同样的紧凑的表述支持特征学习、自我表达和全球光谱分配。

blocks.en: Contributions. (1) We introduce a two-factor projector model for joint feature and self-expression learning with orthogonality-preserving updates. (2) We construct a support-preserving nonnegative affinity and derive an exact reduction of its normalized spectral problem without forming full pairwise matrices. (3) We quantify the projector approximation to LSR and establish conditions for subspace preservation and connectivity. We also prove linear time and memory bounds for the complete pipeline under fixed dimensions and iteration budgets. (4) Across five image-clustering benchmarks, LoomSC ranks first or second in all 15 15 dataset–metric comparisons against nine baselines. Its mean accuracy exceeds the highest baseline mean by 6.66 6.66 percentage points. Experiments on synthetic data reach 500,000 500{,}000 samples while maintaining at least 99.8 % 99.8\% accuracy throughout the tested range.

blocks.en: II Related work
blocks.zh: 二. 有关工作

blocks.en: In line with the focus of this work, we discuss the advantages and limitations of two existing subspace clustering categories: the scalable subspace clustering category and the deep subspace clustering category. In that respect, we highlight the pertinence of introducing a subspace clustering approach that combines the advantages of both categories.
blocks.zh: 根据这项工作的重点,我们讨论两个已存在的子空间集群类别的优点和局限性:可伸缩子空间集群类别和深子空间集群类别. 在这方面,我们强调采用将两个类别的好处结合起来的亚空间分组办法的重要性。

blocks.en: II-A Scalable subspace clustering:
blocks.zh: II-A 可缩放子空间集群:

blocks.en: Least-squares regression (LSR) [ 9 ] provides an efficient alternative to sparse coefficient estimation. Its squared Frobenius regularization encourages a grouping effect among correlated samples and admits a closed-form solution. However, solving the regression analytically does not eliminate the dense n × n n\times n coefficient matrix, where n n is the number of samples. Its explicit construction and storage remain quadratic in n n . Thus, improving the regression solver alone does not resolve the full-affinity bottleneck. LoomSC instead adopts a prescribed-width projector model and learns its thin factors directly. This changes the representation of self-expression rather than merely accelerating a dense coefficient solve.
blocks.zh: 最小平方回归(LSR)[9]提供了一个替代稀有系数估算的有效方法. 它平方的弗罗贝尼乌斯规范化鼓励了相关样品之间的组合效应并承认了封闭式溶液. 然而,从分析角度解决回归并不能消除密集的n×n\times n系数矩阵,其中n是样本数量. 其清晰的构造和储存仍为n n 的四相结构。 因此,仅靠改进回归解决方案并不能解决全面存在的瓶颈。 LoomSC转而采用规定宽度的投影器模型并直接学习其细小的因子. 这改变了自我表达的表达方式,而不只是加速了密集系数的解.

blocks.en: Sparse methods reduce storage by retaining a small number of coefficients per sample. SSC-OMP [ 18 ] replaces ℓ 1 \ell_{1} optimization with orthogonal matching pursuit and establishes subspace-preserving guarantees under suitable conditions. EnSC [ 19 ] combines ℓ 1 \ell_{1} and squared ℓ 2 \ell_{2} regularization to balance subspace preservation and graph connectivity. Its oracle-guided active-set solver restricts optimization to candidate dictionary elements. Both approaches substantially accelerate coefficient estimation. Nevertheless, their dictionary searches still compare target residuals with the full dataset. Repeating these searches across samples retains a quadratic sample-size dependence for fixed sparsity and search budgets. Sparse spectral solvers reduce the subsequent graph-processing cost, but do not remove this coefficient-estimation cost. LoomSC avoids these separate full-dictionary searches by optimizing a shared factorization through thin matrix products and an orthogonal Procrustes update.
blocks.zh: 分层法通过每个样本保留少量系数来减少存储. SSC-OMP [18] 替换了 1\ell\% 1} 优化与正对齐的追求, 并在适当条件下建立子空间保存保证. EnSC [19] 结合了l 1\ell\1}和平方 l 2\ell\2}规范化,以平衡子空间的保存和图表连接. 它的oracle-guided活性集解器将优化限制在候选词典元素上. 这两种方法都大大地加速了系数估计。 尽管如此,他们的字典搜索仍然将目标残存与完整的数据集进行比较. 重复这些在样本间的搜索保留了四相样本大小的依赖性,用于固定的抽筋和搜索预算. Sparse光谱解析器会降低之后的图处理成本,但不会去除这个系数估计成本. LoomSC避免了这些单独的全词典搜索,方法是通过稀薄的矩阵产品和正交Procrustes更新来优化共享的保理化.

blocks.en: Stochastic sparse subspace clustering (SSSC) [ 20 ] addresses weak within-subspace connectivity through dictionary dropout. For normalized samples, the expected dropout objective induces an additional squared ℓ 2 \ell_{2} penalty, which encourages denser representations. Its scalable implementation combines coefficients from multiple reduced dictionaries through a consensus formulation. This improves connectivity while preserving a sparse affinity. However, with a fixed retained fraction, each dictionary still grows with n n , and the reduced regression must be repeated for every target. Parallel execution accelerates these subproblems without changing their aggregate arithmetic complexity. LoomSC obtains compactness through a common learned latent factor rather than repeated stochastic dictionary reduction. The resulting sample relations are represented jointly without an ensemble of coefficient estimates.
blocks.zh: Stochastic spark 子空间集群(SSSC)[20]通过字典的退出解决子空间内部连接薄弱的问题. 对于正常的样本,预期的退学目标会导致额外的平方 l 2\ell\2}惩罚,这鼓励了更密集的表述. 其可扩展的执行通过协商一致的提法结合了多个已缩小字典的系数. 这既能改善连通性,又能保持稀少的亲和. 然而,用一个固定保留分数,每个字典仍然会以 n 来增长,而减少的回归必须重复到每个目标. 平行执行可以加速这些子问题而不改变其总算复杂度. LoomSC通过共同学习的潜入因素,而不是重复地缩写字典,获得紧凑性. 由此产生的抽样关系是联合表示的,没有一系列系数估计数。

blocks.en: Representative-based approaches reduce the dictionary size more directly. LMVSC [ 15 ] learns nonnegative sample-to-anchor coefficients and computes its spectral embedding from a compact normalized factor. SGL [ 16 ] further couples anchor-graph learning with a spectral constraint that targets k k connected components. These methods achieve linear sample-size scaling for fixed anchor and optimization budgets. Their graph weights are learned, but their reconstruction is performed using supplied features and an anchor dictionary. Consequently, they do not jointly adapt the image representation to the self-expression objective. LoomSC preserves a compact representation while learning both the encoder and the latent factor. After initialization, the columns of the latent factor are updated from all samples rather than remaining fixed anchor representatives. Unlike the nonnegative anchor weights in LMVSC and SGL, its sample-factor coefficients can be signed. This permits linear combinations beyond convex anchor assignments.
blocks.zh: 以代表为基础的办法更直接地缩小字典的篇幅。 LMVSC [15] 学习非阴性样本到定点系数,并从紧凑的正态系数来计算其光谱嵌入. SGL [16] 进一步的夫妇锚图学习,具有以k相接组件为目标的光谱约束. 这些方法实现了固定锚地预算的线性样本规模缩放和优化. 他们的图分被学习出,但他们的重建是使用所提供的特性和一个锚地词典进行的. 因此,它们不使图像表现与自我表达目标相结合。 LoomSC在学习编码器和潜在因素的同时保留了紧凑的表示. 初始化后,从所有样本中更新潜在系数的柱子,而不是剩余的固定锚代表. 与LMVSC和SGL中的非负锚权重不同,其样本因子系数可以被签名. 这允许线性组合超越对流锚地任务.

blocks.en: Selective sampling-based scalable sparse subspace clustering (S 5 C) [ 29 ] selects representatives using stochastic estimates of subgradient violations. It then solves restricted sparse regressions for all samples. Its spectral stage exploits a graph with only O ⁡ ( n ​ m ) O(nm) nonzero entries, where m m is the representative budget. Thus, S 5 C reduces both regression and spectral costs without requiring a dense affinity. However, its representation remains tied to selected samples in the feature space. LoomSC replaces this exemplar dictionary with adaptive latent directions and jointly refines the features used to construct them.
blocks.zh: 选择性采样基于可缩放的稀有子空间集群(S 5 C)[29] 选取代表使用分层估计分层违规. 然后可以解决所有样本的有限稀有回归. 其光谱相利用的图中只有O ⁡ (n mi) O (nm) 非零分条目,其中m m为代表预算. 因此,S 5 C既能降低回归成本,又能降低光谱成本,而不需要密集的亲和性. 然而,其代表性仍然与地物空间中的某些样本有关。 LoomSC用适应性潜入方向来取而代之地取而代之的是这个实例词典,并共同完善了用来构建它们的特点.

blocks.en: A-DSSC [ 22 ] addresses a different source of difficulty: the compatibility between self-expression coefficients and spectral normalization. It first estimates coefficients and then obtains a doubly stochastic affinity through quadratically regularized optimal transport. A support-restricted solver exploits sparsity to accelerate this second stage. This gives a principled alternative to heuristic coefficient normalization, but retains separate coefficient-estimation and transport problems. LoomSC instead derives the affinity and its normalization from the same learned projector. For its squared affinity, each degree equals the squared norm of the corresponding sample-factor row. Thus, degree computation requires only the thin factor and no additional transport optimization.
blocks.zh: A-DSSC [22]解决了不同的困难来源:自我表达系数和光谱正常化之间的相容性. 它首先估计出系数,然后通过四相正轨化的最佳运输方式获得双相通性。 支持受限制的解药会利用斯皮克来加速这一第二阶段. 这为热系数正常化提供了有原则的替代办法,但保留了单独的系数估计和运输问题。 相反地,LoomSC的亲和性及其正常化来源于同一精通的投影仪。 对于它的平方相近性,每分相等同相应的样因子行的平方相通. 因此,度量计算只需要瘦因子,不需要额外的迁移优化.

blocks.en: Compact spectral computation also appears in scalable attributed-graph subspace clustering (SAGSC) [ 30 ] . SAGSC constructs a projector from graph-smoothed features and uses a quadratic kernel to obtain a nonnegative factorized affinity. This permits spectral clustering without explicitly assembling pairwise weights. LoomSC applies this spectral principle to jointly learned image representations rather than fixed graph-smoothed features. Its two-factor objective allows the projector to evolve with the encoder, and its analysis connects the learned factors to dominant latent directions and subspace structure. The distinction is therefore the integration of adaptive representation learning with a compact spectral construction, rather than factorization alone.
blocks.zh: 收缩光谱计算也出现在可缩放的归属-图子空间集群(SAGSC) [30]. SAGSC用图平滑的特性构造出一个投影仪,并使用四元内核来得到非负因子化的亲和. 这允许光谱集群,而不明确组合对等重量。 LoomSC将这种光谱原理应用于共同学习的图像表达,而不是固定的相图平滑特征. 其双因子目标允许投影器与编码器一起进化,其分析将所学出的因素与主导潜入方向和子空间结构相接. 因此,区别在于适应性代表学习与紧凑的光谱构造相结合,而不只是因地制宜。

blocks.en: II-B Deep subspace clustering:
blocks.zh: II-B 深亚空间集群:

blocks.en: DSCNet [ 25 ] integrates a differentiable self-expression layer into a convolutional auto-encoder. This couples feature learning with the reconstruction of each latent sample from the others. S 2 ConvSCN [ 26 ] additionally uses spectral assignments to supervise feature learning and coefficient estimation. These formulations make the representation responsive to clustering, but retain a sample-to-sample self-expression matrix. Additional supervision does not remove its quadratic parameter storage. LoomSC retains joint feature and self-expression learning while replacing this layer with two thin factors. Its factor updates admit closed-form solutions, and their dimensions are controlled by the prescribed factor width.
blocks.zh: DSCNet [25] 将可分化的自表达层整合入了革命自编码器. 这对夫妇的特点是学习如何从其他人那里重建每一个潜在的样本。 S 2 ConvSCN [26] 额外使用光谱任务来监督特征学习和系数估计. 这些配体使代表体对集群反应迅速,但保留了样本到样本的自表达矩阵. 附加监管不会移除其四相参数存储. LoomSC保留了联合特征和自我表达学习,同时以两个细小的因素来取而代之. 它的因子更新承认了封闭式解决方案,其尺寸由所指定的因子宽度来控制.

blocks.en: Neural coefficient prediction offers another route to scalability. SENet [ 23 ] parameterizes pairwise coefficients with a neural network that can generalize to unseen samples. Its objective learns a coefficient-prediction rule for the supplied representation rather than jointly learning a new feature space for self-expression. This separates the number of network parameters from the number of coefficient entries. However, a compact predictor does not itself provide a compact spectral representation of the resulting affinity. LoomSC instead learns a sample factor whose algebraic structure supports both self-expression and the subsequent spectral reduction.
blocks.zh: 神经系数预测为可伸缩性提供了另一种途径. SENet [23] 参数将系数与神经网络对等,这种神经网络可以被概括到看不见的样本. 其目标为所提供代表学习系数预测规则,而不是共同学习自我表达的新特征空间。 这把网络参数的数量与系数条目的数量分开. 然而,一个紧凑的预测器本身并没有对由此产生的亲和性提供紧凑的光谱表示. LoomSC转而学习出一个样本因子,其代数结构支持自表达和随后的光谱还原.

blocks.en: PRO-DSC [ 28 ] jointly learns latent representations and self-expression coefficients. A log-determinant regularizer controls representation collapse under the conditions established in its analysis. Its implementation predicts coefficients through neural mappings and Sinkhorn normalization, which supports mini-batch training. The distinction from LoomSC arises at full-set clustering. PRO-DSC constructs the coefficient matrix over the clustering set and applies spectral clustering to the resulting affinity. For n n samples, this inference route retains quadratic matrix storage despite efficient training. LoomSC does not reconstruct a full coefficient matrix after learning. The final sample factor directly defines a nonnegative affinity whose normalized spectral problem is solved in a feature space determined by the factor width. Thus, the computational reduction extends through spectral assignment rather than ending with network training.
blocks.zh: PRO-DSC [28] 共同学习潜在的表达和自我表达系数. 一种确定日志的正则剂控制在其分析中确定的条件下的表示崩溃. 其实施通过神经映射和Sinkhorn正常化预测出系数,后者支持小批量训练. 与LoomSC的区别出现在全集. PRO-DSC在集群组合上构建系数矩阵,并将光谱集群应用于由此产生的亲和性. 对于 n n 样本,尽管训练有效,这一推论路径仍保留了四相矩阵存储. LoomSC 学习后不重建完整的系数矩阵 。 最终样本因子直接定义了非负亲和性,其正常光谱问题由因子宽度决定的特征空间解决. 因此,计算减少是通过光谱分配,而不是通过网络培训结束。

blocks.en: Other deep methods reduce cost by changing how the final partition is obtained. The large-scale extension of pseudo-supervised deep subspace clustering [ 27 ] trains on a subset and assigns the remaining latent samples through nearest-neighbor classification. LoomSC instead retains an explicit model of sample relations while avoiding their dense storage. All samples participate in factor learning, and the final partition is obtained by spectral clustering of the learned affinity rather than by extending labels from a training subset. Its efficiency follows from representing that affinity compactly while preserving the self-expression formulation.
blocks.zh: 其他深层方法通过改变最终分区的获得方式来降低成本. 由伪监督的深层子空间集群[27]列车在一个子集上的大规模延伸,并通过近邻分类来分配所剩的潜在样本. 相反地,LoomSC保留了一个明确的样本关系模型,同时避免了它们的密集存储. 所有样本都参与因子学习,而最终分出的方法是通过对所学到的亲缘性进行光谱分组,而不是通过从训练子集中扩展标签来得到. 它的效率来自在保留自我表达表达方式的同时紧紧地代表这种亲和。

blocks.en: The proposed method develops a compact self-representation by exploiting the spectral structure of least-squares regression (LSR). We first analyze the LSR solution and motivate a projector approximation. We then express this approximation through two thin factors that are learned jointly with a deep auto-encoder. Finally, we construct a nonnegative affinity from the learned factors and obtain the spectral embedding through a reduced eigenproblem. Both phases operate directly on the factors, which makes their computational cost linear.

blocks.en: We evaluate LoomSC on five image-clustering benchmarks. The face datasets are Extended YaleB (EYaleB), ORL, and UMIST, with ( n , k ) = ( 2,432 , 38 ) (n,k)=(2{,}432,38) , ( 400 , 40 ) (400,40) , and ( 575 , 20 ) (575,20) , respectively. We also use COIL-100 with 7,200 7{,}200 images from 100 100 object classes and a balanced subset of Fashion-MNIST with 5,000 5{,}000 images from 10 10 classes. Each sample is normalized to unit ℓ 2 \ell_{2} norm. Tables I and IV specify the sample counts used in the comparisons.

blocks.en: We compare with nine baselines that distinguish deep representation learning from computational scalability. The scalable non-deep methods comprise two groups. LMVSC [ 15 ] , SGL [ 16 ] , and S 5 C [ 29 ] use sampling or anchor-based reduction. EnSC [ 19 ] , SSC-OMP [ 18 ] , A-DSSC [ 22 ] , and SSSC [ 20 ] accelerate self-expression estimation without learning deep representations. These methods target scalability, but do not all achieve linear complexity for the complete clustering pipeline.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了9个基线,这些基线区分了深度表达学习和计算可伸缩性。 可伸缩的非深法由两组组成. LMVSC [15],SGL [16],和S 5 C [29]使用采样或锚基还原. ENSC [19],SSC-OMP [18],A-DSSC [22],SSSC [20] 加快自我表达估计,而无需学习深层表述. 这些方法以可伸缩性为目标,但并非所有方法都为完整的集群管实现线性复杂.

blocks.en: The non-linear-time full-affinity references are LSR [ 9 ] and PRO-DSC [ 28 ] . LSR is non-deep and computes a dense self-expression matrix. PRO-DSC is deep and supports mini-batch training. Its published spectral inference nevertheless constructs pairwise coefficients over the clustering set and processes the resulting affinity. Thus, scalable training does not eliminate its full-affinity spectral bottleneck. LoomSC combines deep representation learning with factorized self-expression and spectral assignment. Its complete pipeline has linear time and memory complexity in n n for fixed architecture, dimensions, factor width, and iteration budgets.
blocks.zh: 非线性全方位引用为LSR [9]和PRO-DSC [28]. LSR是非深的并计算出一个密集的自表达矩阵. PRO-DSC很深,支持小批量训练. 然而,它公布的光谱推论在集群组合上构建成对系数,并处理由此产生的亲和性。 因此,可扩展的训练并不能消除其全能光谱瓶颈. LoomSC将深度表现学习与要素化的自我表达和光谱分配相结合. 其完整的管道在nn中具有线性时间和内存复杂性,用于固定架构,维度,因子宽度和迭代预算.

blocks.en: For LoomSC, we use the same architecture and optimization hyperparameters across all datasets. The encoder contains L = 3 L=3 convolutional layers with 10 10 , 20 20 , and 30 30 output channels and kernel sizes 5 × 5 5\times 5 , 3 × 3 3\times 3 , and 3 × 3 3\times 3 , respectively. Each layer uses stride 2 2 and a ReLU activation, with no batch normalization. The decoder mirrors the encoder using transposed convolutions. The resulting convolutional representation has size 30 × 6 × 6 30\times 6\times 6 , which gives a flattened latent dimension of d z = 1080 d_{z}=1080 . We set the factor width to m = 380 m=380 for all datasets. The auto-encoder is first pretrained for 5,000 5{,}000 epochs using full-batch Adam with a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} . No data augmentation, weight decay, or learning-rate scheduling is used.

The spectral embedding dimension is set to the target number of clusters k k , after which k k -means produces the final partition.

blocks.en: LoomSC achieves higher ACC than every scalable non-deep baseline on all five datasets. The improvements over the strongest method in this group range from 3.98 3.98 to 8.17 8.17 points. The gains over sampling-based methods are larger. Relative to the best ACC among LMVSC, SGL, and S 5 C, LoomSC improves by 23.92 23.92 points on ORL and 25.14 25.14 points on COIL-100. The corresponding gains are 15.00 15.00 points on UMIST and 72.32 72.32 points on EYaleB. These comparisons show that a compact model need not be restricted to the clustering quality of fixed-representation sampling methods. LoomSC retains compactness while jointly refining the latent features and their self-expression factors.

blocks.en: The distinction from PRO-DSC concerns the complete clustering pipeline rather than network training alone. PRO-DSC reduces training costs through mini-batches, but its published inference constructs a full pairwise affinity before spectral clustering [ 28 ] . Explicitly storing this affinity requires O ⁡ ( n 2 ) O(n^{2}) memory for a clustering set of size n n . LoomSC instead retains P ∈ ℝ n × m P\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times m} and L ∈ ℝ d z × m L\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{z}\times m} during representation learning. Its quadratic feature map transfers spectral computation to dimension q = m ⁡ ( m + 1 ) / 2 q=m(m+1)/2 , which is independent of n n for fixed m m . Consequently, it removes the full-affinity bottleneck rather than only accelerating its construction. Section III-G establishes linear time and memory in n n under fixed dimensions and iteration budgets.
blocks.zh: 与PRO-DSC的区别涉及完整的集群管道,而不仅仅是网络培训。 PRO-DSC通过微型波纹管来降低培训费用,但其所发表的推论在光谱集成[28]之前构建出完整的对接性. 明确存储此亲和性需要O QQ (n 2 ) O(n^{2}) 内存,用于组合大小为n n 的组合. 转而保留P QQ Rn × m P\in\ mathb{R}^{n\times m}和 L\\R d z × m L\in\mathb{R}^{d_{z}\times m}在代表学习过程中. 其四相特征映射会将光谱计算转移至相位 q = m → (m + 1 ) / 2 q = m (m +1 )/2,该映射对固定相位 m 独立于 n. 因此,它消除了全方位的瓶颈,而不是仅仅加快了它的建设。 第三-G节在固定维度和迭代预算下以n确定线性时间和内存.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: This work presents LoomSC, a scalable subspace clustering framework that combines projector-based self-expression with exact spectral reduction. Jointly learning latent representations and two thin factors avoids explicit sample-by-sample coefficient matrices. A nonnegative quadratic affinity preserves the projector’s support and enables normalized spectral clustering without forming the full affinity or sample Laplacian. For fixed dimensions and iteration budgets, the complete pipeline has linear time and memory complexity in the number of samples. Our analysis quantifies the projector approximation to regularized least squares. It also identifies conditions under which the full row-space projector preserves subspace memberships and ensures within-subspace connectivity.
blocks.zh: 这项工作呈现出LoomSC,一个可伸缩的子空间集群框架,将投影自表达与精确的光谱还原相结合. 联合学习潜在表示和两个细小的因素避免了明显的逐个样本系数矩阵. 非负四相近性保留了投影器的支持并使得光谱集成正常化,而不会形成完全相近性或样品Laplacian. 对于固定尺寸和迭代预算,完整的管道在样本数量上有线性时间和内存的复杂性. 我们的分析把投影仪 近似于普通化最小的平方 它还确定了全行-空间投影仪在哪些条件下保留了子空间成员,并确保了子空间内部的连通性.

blocks.en: Across five image-clustering benchmarks, LoomSC achieves the highest average ACC, NMI, and ARI among the evaluated methods. Synthetic experiments extend to 500,000 500{,}000 samples while maintaining at least 99.8 % 99.8\% accuracy throughout the tested range. These findings demonstrate that compact self-expression can combine strong clustering quality with scalability across both representation learning and spectral assignment.
blocks.zh: 在五个图像分组基准中,LoomSC在评估方法中实现了最高平均水平ACC、NMI和ARI。 合成实验扩展到50万个500{,}000个样本,同时在整个被测试范围内至少保持99.8%的精度. 这些调查结果表明,紧凑的自我表达可以把强聚质量与代表性学习和光谱分配的可扩展性结合起来。

blocks.en: The comparison identifies the source of LoomSC’s scalability advantage. LMVSC [ 15 ] , SGL [ 16 ] , and S 5 C [ 29 ] already have linear sample-size dependence for fixed representative and solver budgets. LoomSC retains this dependence while jointly learning nonlinear features and the two self-expression factors. EnSC [ 19 ] and SSC-OMP [ 18 ] can reduce coefficient storage through sparsity, but their dictionary scans still compare each target with the full dataset. SSSC reduces the dictionary size by dropout, giving the explicit R drop ​ ρ ​ n 2 R_{\mathrm{drop}}\rho n^{2} dependence in the table [ 20 ] . PRO-DSC [ 28 ] instead improves the training stage through mini-batches, while its full-affinity spectral inference retains quadratic storage. LoomSC avoids explicitly constructing either n × n n\times n matrix. Its q q -dimensional reduction is exact for the defined squared affinity. For fixed m m and solver budgets, both its learned factors and its reduced spectral computation scale linearly with n n . Thus, LoomSC combines deep representation learning with scalability through the final clustering stage.
